argv: Critique the existing URL Activity Scanner results interface for batch readability, information hierarchy, accessibility and responsive usability while preserving its technical dark design identity

Improve the existing desktop-first URL Activity Scanner results experience for technical users reviewing batches of up to 100 URLs. Prioritize information hierarchy, dense readable results, status summaries, keyboard accessibility, contrast, export accessibility and responsive usability while preserving the existing dark technical identity.

Audit the improved URL Activity Scanner results interface for keyboard accessibility, focus recovery, contrast, readable technical data, batch summary accuracy, desktop and mobile usability, result-key navigation and CSV export accessibility.
dense data table status results readability scanning batch

Refine the existing desktop help-desk console where support agents triage several hundred open tickets per shift: make queue rows quicker to scan, show ticket priority and SLA status clearly, and keep row actions reachable from the keyboard. Keep the current light theme and component library.
Design a new control-room dashboard for an electricity grid operator showing live load, outage alarms and 24-hour demand forecasts on large desktop monitors. There is no existing brand to follow.
Build a mobile-first checkout for a grocery delivery web shop. Most customers order on phones with one hand, so prioritise thumb-reachable actions, large touch targets and quick address entry.
Audit the native iOS and Android settings screens for touch target size, dynamic type scaling and screen reader labels on icon-only buttons.

Add a billing settings page to our existing SaaS admin using its established design-system tokens, components and Inter typography. Do not introduce new colours or fonts; every field needs a visible label and clear inline errors.
Create a visual identity for an independent bookshop's events website: warm, literary and editorial, with readable long-form event descriptions. No existing brand exists.
Critique the first-run onboarding screens of a meditation web app: does the calm aesthetic support comprehension, is the visual hierarchy clear, and is motion restrained?
Audit a modal-heavy admin panel for focus trapping, escape to close, visible focus indicators, and disabled and loading button states.
Rename the CSV export column header from 'Checked' to 'Checked at' in the backend serializer.
Redesign the donation landing page for a children's hospital charity. Do not use dark mode, glassmorphism or decorative animation; prioritise legibility for older donors.
Review the desktop trading blotter's order table for scan speed, numeric alignment and whether status colours can be told apart without relying on colour alone.
